cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Dairy technology describes the technology, physics, chemistry and microbiology of pasteurised and longlife milk, cream, butter, cheese, condensed milk, milk powder, yoghurt and other fermented milk beverages, ice cream and other dairy products. This subject is segmented at lectures and laboratory exercises.
